IsCapableToPerform.note: Conditional client/supplier combinations in the normative IsCapableOfPerforming constraints; ProjectActivity is explicitly excluded from the general ResourcePerformer branch.

PerformsInContext.note: Conditional role/action pairings from the normative client and supplier constraints.

Implements.note: Client (implementation) points to supplier (specification). Cross-domain combinations are checked as pairs, never as an unconstrained Cartesian product.

CapabilityGeneralization.origin: UML Generalization adapter named in NATO guideline C1
CapabilityGeneralization.note: Specific capability points to generic capability; this is not a native stereotype in the UAFP XML.

CapabilityDependency.origin: NATO guideline C3 CapabilityDependency DMM tuple adapter
CapabilityDependency.note: Dependent capability points to independent capability. Not a native stereotype in the UAFP XML.

ServiceGeneralization.origin: UML Generalization adapter for NATO guideline S1
ServiceGeneralization.note: Specific service specification points to generic service specification.

OperationalGeneralization.origin: UML Generalization adapter for NATO guideline L1

ResourceGeneralization.origin: UML Generalization adapter for NATO guideline P1

Refine.origin: SysML Refine adapter used in NATO guideline C8
Refine.note: Requirement is an external SysML concept; it is an explicit adapter type, not a native UAF stereotype.
